The lid and seat tasks are ALIX's plans, made with the UGV at 250 mm from the commode and no offset: place the UGV there for them (Lite cannot see the placement).

Open the lid, then each arm's pole and hand back to before Open the lid (49.0-108.2 s) is ALIX's plan: its hands hold the lid and the seat by design, so it is left out of this collision check (ALIX's planner checked it with the commode's contact allowances); its camera checks are assumed here, and asked of the camera in Real.
